categories.main_business_segments: Shizuoka Gas operates primarily in two main business segments: Gas (including city gas and LNG) and LPG & Other Energy (including LPG, electricity, and on-site energy services). The company also engages in related engineering, housing equipment sales, and other ancillary services through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on the import, storage, and distribution of LNG, the manufacture and supply of city gas, and the operation of extensive gas pipeline networks. It utilizes advanced gas processing, metering, and safety management systems, and employs both co-generation and IoT-based energy management solutions for efficiency and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shizuoka Gas serves a broad customer base including residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale clients. Major end markets include households, commercial facilities, factories, and other gas utilities, with significant wholesale supply to companies such as INPEX and Sala Energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are concentrated in Shizuoka Prefecture and surrounding regions in Japan, with additional activities in Nagano and Niigata through subsidiaries. Internationally, it has a presence in Singapore (LNG trading), India (energy business development), and Vietnam (solar power joint venture).
categories.supply_chain_position: Shizuoka Gas operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, handling LNG importation, city gas production, pipeline distribution, and direct sales to end users, as well as electricity and LPG supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the customer base, promoting the shift to natural gas, advancing carbon neutrality, and developing renewable energy sources such as solar and biomass. The company emphasizes digital transformation (DX), energy efficiency, and the development of new business domains both domestically and overseas, particularly in Southeast Asia and India. While there is no formal R&D division, innovation is pursued through business development and alliances.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of city gas, LNG, LPG, and electricity, as well as through engineering services, equipment sales, and on-site energy solutions. The company also earns revenue from construction, maintenance, and leasing services provided by its subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other regional gas utilities, electricity companies, and diversified energy providers such as Tokyo Gas, Chubu Electric Power, and TOKAI Holdings. Shizuoka Gas is a leading regional player with a strong local market share and a reputation for reliability and safety, but faces increasing competition due to energy market liberalization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated net sales were ¥202.2 billion, with operating profit of ¥10.3 billion and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥8.8 billion. The company has a stable financial base with a high equity ratio (69.4%), moderate leverage, and a workforce of approximately 1,464 employees. While revenue declined slightly year-on-year due to lower gas unit prices, the company maintains a solid growth profile in its LPG, electricity, and renewable energy businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shizuoka Gas differentiates itself through its commitment to safety, stable supply, and customer-centric services, including energy efficiency solutions and carbon-neutral gas offerings. The company leverages its regional expertise, integrated energy solutions, and strong community ties to provide reliable, environmentally conscious energy and value-added services tailored to local needs.
